description: Mailchimp campaign PERFORMANCE: emails sent, unique opens and open rate (and the rate without machine opens), unique clicks and click rate, unsubscribes, bounces, abuse reports and, where a store is connected to Mailchimp, orders and REVENUE, per campaign sent in the last `days` (default 30), or one campaign by campaignId. Rates are fractions (0.25 = 25%). Read-only, free. Needs Mailchimp connected (Connectors > Mailchimp, or connect_connector with an API key).
name: mailchimp_report
title: Mailchimp campaign performance
